content: As noted eg. in BIBREF19 , BIBREF20 , artificial parallel data obtained through forward-translation (FT) can also prove advantageous and we also consider a FT system (fwdtrans-nmt): in this case the target side of the corpus is artificial and is generated using the baseline NMT applied to a natural source.
